title: 第9章 刚准备跑路你说你练成了第10章 一日练气上古修仙妖孽
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 一顿饭饱。
萧火火笨拙收拾著地面上的碗筷。
待收拾完毕后，他盯著楚风看了一阵，神色之中有些犹豫，似有什么要说问一番，但犹豫过后还是作罢。
关上茅房门，簫火火猛的拍打著脸，有些懊恼的道：
“师尊不可能看不出来我还练不出灵气。”
“他之所以选择不帮我，一定是因为他足够相信我，相信我能自行悟出其中的玄妙。”
“我怎么能產生去问师尊的想法呢？”
自言自语了一番，簫火火稚气未脱的脸上还是有著一丝颓废：
“现在三天时间过去了，仍旧是一点动静都没有。”
“难道，我不是练武的料，也不是练气的料？”
忽然，他的神色变得坚定：
“不对，师尊既然肯將此门大道之法教於我，肯定就说明我一定是有著这方面的天赋。”
平息了一下內心，簫火火坐上吱呀作响的床板，闭目依照楚风所给的修炼方式，进行吐纳。
茅屋外，楚风定著站了许久，眉头紧缩。
低头思索道：
“方才他看了我许久，不会是练不出来开始怀疑我了吧？”
这个可怕的念头刚刚出现，楚风就猛的摇头否决了：
“不对，他应当是修不出灵气，想要问我，但却但却了。”
“一定是这样。”
得出了这个结论，楚风的眉头依旧松不下来。
因为上面两种情况，哪种都不是什么好事。
萧火火现在依旧悟不出任何的灵力。
这几天为了安心，他自己也试了试，结果也是一无所获。
很可能说明，这套根本就行不通。
他左右踱步，一步一嘆息。
高悬在空中的烈日不知不觉间，就沉到了山谷之下。
傍晚时分，天地昏暗，空气变得冷清，一股凉意在林间瀰漫。
可房屋之中闭眼静坐著的少年，却浑身湿漉漉的冒著汗珠。
萧火火依旧紧紧的皱著眉，按照著吐纳术进行吐息。
从鼻尖吸入，流遍全身，再到全身肌肉鬆缓排出体外。
在进行吐纳呼吸的过程中，依旧默念运转著师尊所给的功法。
content_en:
A full meal.
Xiao Huohuo clumsily cleared away the dishes on the ground.
After finishing cleaning up, he stared at Chu Feng for a while, looking a little hesitant, as if he wanted to ask something, but he gave up after hesitating.
After closing the latrine door, Xiao Huohuo slapped his face fiercely and said with some annoyance:
"It's impossible for Master to fail to see that I still can't practice spiritual energy."
"The reason why he chose not to help me must be because he believed in me enough and believed that I could understand the mystery on my own."
"How could I have the idea to ask Master?"
After talking to himself for a while, Xiao Huohuo still had a trace of decadence on his childish face:
"Now three days have passed and there is still no movement at all."
"Could it be that I'm not good at martial arts or qi training?"
Suddenly, his expression became firm:
"No, since Master is willing to teach me this great method, it definitely means that I must have a talent in this area."
After calming down for a while, Xiao Huohuo sat on the creaky bed, closed his eyes and breathed in and out according to the cultivation method given by Chu Feng.
Outside the hut, Chu Feng stood still for a long time, his brows furrowed.
He lowered his head and thought:
"He looked at me for a long time just now. Could it be that he couldn't practice enough and started to doubt me?"
As soon as this terrible idea appeared, Chu Feng shook his head and rejected it:
"No, he must be unable to cultivate spiritual energy. He wanted to ask me, but he couldn't."
"That must be it."
After coming to this conclusion, Chu Feng's brows still couldn't relax.
Because neither of the above two situations is a good thing.
Xiao Huohuo still can't realize any spiritual power.
In order to feel at ease these days, he also tried it himself, but found nothing.
It probably means that this approach simply won’t work.
He paced left and right, sighing every step of the way.
The scorching sun hanging high in the sky sank below the valley without realizing it.
In the evening, the sky and earth were dark, the air became cold, and a coolness filled the forest.
But the young man sitting quietly in the house with his eyes closed was dripping with sweat.
Xiao Huohuo still frowned tightly and breathed according to the breathing technique.
Inhale from the tip of the nose, flow throughout the body, and then be expelled from the body through relaxed muscles throughout the body.
During the process of exhaling and breathing, I still silently recited and performed the exercises given by Master.
